headline: Adopted revised grant decision rubric and dropped one grant application question.
summary: Laurie Spira-Savett was named chair of the grants committee. The group reviewed the grants timeline and adopted the proposed decision rubric with changes. It also dropped one application question and updated dates on the Project Budget Form.
decisions: Approved Laurie Spira-Savett as Grants Committee chair; motion carried.
Adopted the proposed grant decision rubric with changes recommended by the group.
Approved eliminating one application question and updating dates on the Project Budget Form; motion carried.
Scheduled the January review meeting and a back-up date.

plain_text:
Nashua Arts Commission 
Grants Committee Meeting 
November 10, 2026 at City Hall 
 
In attendance: Sara Ceaser, Jenn Annand, Jane Marquis, Faith Mandravelis Laurie Spira-Savett 
 
9:22   Meeting called to order 
Motion to appoint Laurie Spira-Savett as Grants Committee Chair by Jenn Annand, seconded by 
Jane Marquis, motion carried. 
Discussion of the following: 
• Reviewed and discussed Grants process timeline. 
• Discussed current and proposed decision rubric and agreed to adopt the proposed rubric 
with changes recommended by the group.  
• Discussed changes recommended by Arts Commissioner Moll and as a result decided to 
eliminate one application question about (whether project is a request for continued 
funding / existing program / new project) and update the dates on the Project Budget 
Form. Motion to eliminate question made by Jane Marquis, seconded by Faith 
Mandravelis, motion carried. 
• Following the 2027 cycle and before the 2028 grants cycle we will discuss whether 
requesting 3 years of budget data in the latter is useful for the decision process.  
• Scheduled the January review meeting as well as a back-up date.  
 
10:34 Adjourn 
 
Submitted by Laurie Spira-Savett
